templates.why_chosen: Two mirrored mode panels bridged by a single central block that names the thing that changes.
templates.what_to_learn: For mode/state comparisons, put the transition operator physically between the panels rather than beside them.

templates.why_chosen: Memory Mode and Compute Mode panels mirror the identical Driver plus Memory-circuits grid, differing only in which GIA/GIAb/IA signals are active, meeting at the green Change Driver INPUT block that is the actual mode switch.
templates.what_to_learn: Use a mirrored pair to show one device in two operating modes, not just two devices: draw the exact same internal grid twice, side by side, and let one small accent-coloured block between them carry all the labelled signals that actually change between modes.
